Dear Dr. Henderson,

Thank you for evaluating this 23-year-old male accountant who presents for clinical review. He takes occasional paracetamol for mild degenerative joint wear affecting his knees. His past medical history is otherwise unremarkable, and he reports no known food allergies.

On examination, he has a disproportionately tall habitus with noticeably long limbs relative to his trunk. Craniofacial inspection reveals a distinctly elongated cranium, hypoplastic cheekbones, a recessed, diminutive mandible, and low-implanted ears. His forehead displays no frontal bossing, the nasal contour is average without prominence, intercanthal spacing is normal, and there are no epicanthal folds. He wears corrective lenses for nearsightedness; sclerae are clear white, the corneas lack conical deformity, and there is no strabismus. An oral examination demonstrates a tall, narrow arch to the palate, though the uvula is normal and undivided.

His chest displays an anterior protrusion of the sternum without any inward depression, and his spine shows no lateral curvature. Cardiovascular evaluation confirms mitral valve billowing with an associated mitral regurgitant jet; however, imaging showed no patent ductus arteriosus, no coronary artery dissection, and no tortuous arterial pathways. The abdomen is soft, with no hiatal, umbilical, or inguinal hernias. Genital inspection shows no abnormal urethral opening.

Musculoskeletal assessment reveals fixed flexion contractures of the proximal interphalangeal joints, but no slender spider-like fingers. He exhibits knock-knee alignment, flattened longitudinal arches, and equinovalgus positioning of his feet. There is no peripheral joint laxity and no history of joint dislocations. Dermatologically, he has markedly hyperelastic skin alongside prominent cutaneous translucency with superficial veins visible, as well as multiple violaceous stretch marks. Crucially, there are no papyraceous or cigarette-paper scars, no easy bruising, and the legs lack varicose veins.

I would appreciate your expert assessment regarding these features.

Sincerely,
